howtos.title: Run the weight-reading prompts on a local model
howtos.what: Simon Willison's setup for testing whether a local Qwen model can name a game from raw network weights.
copy: Get the exp1_which_game prompts from the paper's GitHub repo RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs.
Serve Qwen 3.8 27B (17GB) in LM Studio and install the llm-lmstudio plugin for the LLM CLI.
Raise the context above LM Studio's default 8192, which failed.
Set LMSTUDIO_TIMEOUT=900 to allow long runs.
Run: llm -f <prompt URL> -m lmstudio/qwen/qwen3.8-27b and expect 46 to 65 minutes per prompt.
howtos.whenToUse: When you want to check claims about models reading weights yourself, on your own hardware.
